name: VDO Classic M
description: Built from a photo of a classic VDO round-dial cluster: the photo is the background, with live needles (speed, revs, fuel, coolant, consumption, oil temperature), odometer, trip, a boost panel and the warning lights lit by their signals.

components.name: Fuel consumption: dial face over the needle
Oil temperature: dial face over the needle
DSC off, DTC or MDM (not ON)
